title: Baby Shark
description: A bright undersea adventure: help Baby Shark find the family, surfing, skating and bodyboarding along the way.

title: Blackbelt Deluxe
description: The 1986 martial-arts table reimagined, with nine modes, five side missions and combo-driven multiball.

title: Clown Deluxe
description: The 1985 Clown table modernized: spell C-L-O-W-N and play four zany mini games in a chaotic circus theme.

title: Dinosaur Dynasty 3: Sky Titans
description: Prehistoric flyers rule the skies. Hit moving targets and chain combos into Pteranodon and Sky Titan multiballs.

title: Dr. Seuss Pinball Pack 2
description: Four Dr. Seuss books as tables: ABC, Green Eggs and Ham, One Fish Two Fish, and Oh, the Places You'll Go!

title: Earth Wind Fire Deluxe
description: The 1981 original turned into a magic quest: five spell modes and five mini games among wizards and dragons.

title: Firefighter: Wildlands
description: Lead a Hotshot crew against a forest wildfire: evacuate civilians, cut fire lines and reach 100% containment.

title: Future World Deluxe
description: The 1978 space table rebuilt: five cosmic modes and six planet-themed mini games across the solar system.

title: Gangsters
description: A 2011 table brought back from the vault: climb the 90s criminal underworld by cracking safes and taking risks.

title: Granada Deluxe
description: The 1974 Granada reimagined around the culture and landmarks of Andalusia, with food-themed modes and mini games.

title: Locomotion Deluxe
description: A Wild West train under bandit attack: fight off a gang of colorful outlaws along the tracks.

title: Magic Castle Deluxe
description: The 1980 fantasy fortress revamped: six C-A-S-T-L-E modes, four mini games, and dungeon and cage bonuses.

title: Magic Castle EM+
description: A spooky castle in the EM+ style: six eerie objectives and bonuses like Bat, Dark and Trapdoor.

title: Mexico Deluxe
description: The 1986 Mexico table refreshed with festival color, six modes, Mexico Mode and multiball.

title: Moon Flight Deluxe
description: The 1976 space table evolved: five mission modes, a repair dock and a high-stakes launch ramp.

title: Natural History Pinball Pack 2
description: Four tables that tour the natural world: Africa, Egypt, Deep Ocean and Polar Expedition.

title: Natural History Pinball Pack 3
description: The third Natural History pack, with Dinosaur Dynasty 2, Insect World, Nature's Fury and World of Microbes.

title: Nautilus EM+
description: A deep-sea table in the EM+ style, mixing electro-mechanical simplicity with early solid-state bonus play.

title: Police: Street Patrol
description: A full shift on patrol: respond to calls, chase suspects, back up fellow officers and help the public.

title: Primal Carnage Deluxe
description: Humans versus dinosaurs on a full-featured table with ramps, drop targets, combos and multiball modes.

description: A 1960s-style Primal Carnage table stripped to the basics: bumpers, slingshots, spot targets and one eject hole.

title: Primal Carnage Solid State
description: An 80s-style Primal Carnage table where you pick a side, human or dinosaur, with waving spot targets.

title: Rare Pinball Pack
description: Three Rare franchises reimagined as pinball: Sea of Thieves, Killer Instinct and Battletoads.

title: Shooting the Rapids Deluxe
description: The 1979 river-canoeing table taken further, with rapids, sacred rivers and challenges like Rapid Combo.

title: Soccer Kings Deluxe
description: The 1982 football table modernized: kick-offs, counter attacks, corners and five match modes.

title: Space Shuttle Deluxe
description: The 1980 Space Shuttle modernized: launch from Earth, cross space, survive a meteor storm and land on Mars.

title: Star God EM+
description: A celestial table in the EM+ style: capture the Sun and Moon and spell S-E-R-P-E-N-T-S across ten objectives.

title: Star's Phoenix EM+
description: A high-stakes casino theme in the EM+ style, with quick shots and risk-and-reward bonuses.

title: Stargod Deluxe
description: The 1980 Star God reimagined: ten SWORD and ARMOR modes, six HELMET mini games and Sunrise Mode.

title: Supersonic Deluxe
description: The 1977 jet table modernized: five flight modes, the Mayday Loop and Super Sonic mode.

title: Supersonic EM+
description: Jet fighters in the EM+ style: clear shots, multipliers and airborne bonuses like the Thrust Loop.

title: TAITO Pinball Tables Volume 1
description: Pinball takes on four TAITO arcade classics: Darius, Front Line, Rastan Saga and Space Invaders.

title: TAITO Pinball Tables Volume 2
description: More TAITO arcade games as pinball tables, including Chack'n Pop, Elevator Action and Operation Wolf.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: The four Turtles battle Shredder and the Foot Clan through New York, with ramps, multiball and a Shredder Bash toy.

title: Tropical Deluxe
description: The 1974 Tropical refreshed as a beach day: four modes, four mini games, kickback and multiball.

title: Tropical EM+
description: Sun, sand and surf in the EM+ style, with layered bonuses and side goals like Surf King and Blue Lagoon.

title: Wood's Queen EM+
description: A jungle table in the EM+ style, with bonuses like Vine, Hidden Path and Roar along winding lanes.

title: Zankor Deluxe
description: An enhanced Zankor jungle trek: make camp, craft a weapon, explore and defeat the spider.
